description: Return a new array with the entries of array, where an entry that is an array is replaced by its entries, down to depth levels. The default depth is 1; a negative depth flattens every level; 0 copies the array. Undefined entries are kept (Adaptive arrays have no holes).

parameters.description: How many levels of nested arrays to flatten. The default is 1; a negative depth flattens every level.
parameters.name: depth
